========================================

========================================

#if __has_include(<endian.h>)
#endif
#if __has_include("x.h")
#endif

---

  (preproc_if
    condition: (call_expression
      function: (identifier)
      arguments: (argument_list
        (system_lib_string))))
  (preproc_if
    condition: (call_expression
      function: (identifier)
      arguments: (argument_list
        (string_literal
          (string_content))))))

========================================

========================================

#endif

---

    condition: (binary_expression
      left: (preproc_defined
        (identifier))
      right: (call_expression
        function: (identifier)
        arguments: (argument_list
          (system_lib_string))))))

       )) {
  }
}

================================================================================
preproc group as an unbraced statement body (dangling if/while/for/do)
================================================================================

void f() {
    if (!x)
#ifdef MAC
        a();
#else
        b();
#endif
    while (x)
#ifdef MAC
        y();
#endif
    for (;;)
#ifdef MAC
        z();
#endif
    do
#ifdef MAC
        w();
#endif
    while (x);
    if (a) s1();
    else
#ifdef MAC
        s2();
#endif
    if (c)
#ifdef MAC
        m();
#endif
    else n();
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list))
    (compound_statement
      (if_statement
        (parenthesized_expression
          (unary_expression
            (identifier)))
        (preproc_ifdef
          (identifier)
          (expression_statement
            (call_expression
              (identifier)
              (argument_list)))
          (preproc_else
            (expression_statement
              (call_expression
                (identifier)
                (argument_list))))))
      (while_statement
        (parenthesized_expression
          (identifier))
        (preproc_ifdef
          (identifier)
          (expression_statement
            (call_expression
              (identifier)
              (argument_list)))))
      (for_statement
        (preproc_ifdef
          (identifier)
          (expression_statement
            (call_expression
              (identifier)
              (argument_list)))))
      (do_statement
        (preproc_ifdef
          (identifier)
          (expression_statement
            (call_expression
              (identifier)
              (argument_list))))
        (parenthesized_expression
          (identifier)))
      (if_statement
        (parenthesized_expression
          (identifier))
        (expression_statement
          (call_expression
            (identifier)
            (argument_list)))
        (else_clause
          (preproc_ifdef
            (identifier)
            (expression_statement
              (call_expression
                (identifier)
                (argument_list))))))
      (if_statement
        (parenthesized_expression
          (identifier))
        (preproc_ifdef
          (identifier)
          (expression_statement
            (call_expression
              (identifier)
              (argument_list))))
        (else_clause
          (expression_statement
            (call_expression
              (identifier)
              (argument_list))))))))

================================================================================
Null directive and `#`-comment lines (bare `#`, `# /* ... */`)
================================================================================

#
# /* ****************************************************** */
# * banner idiom                                            */
# */
#define A 1
#if A
int c(void);
#endif
#pragma whatever
#warning hi
int d(void) {
#
    return 0;
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  (preproc_null)

        (parameter_list
          (parameter_declaration
            (primitive_type))))))
  (preproc_call
    (preproc_directive)
    (preproc_arg))
  (preproc_call
    (preproc_directive)
    (preproc_arg))

    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration

      (preproc_null)

        (number_literal)))))

==================

==================

#if BOOST_WORKAROUND(BOOST_MSVC, < 1300)
#  define OLD 1
#endif
#if CHECK(x, ==, y)
int x;
#endif

    condition: (call_expression

      name: (identifier)
      value: (preproc_arg)))

    condition: (call_expression
      function: (identifier)
      arguments: (argument_list
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))
    (declaration
      type: (primitive_type)
      declarator: (identifier))))
